projects.title: DIY photography light
projects.description: A DIY white / RGB photography light. Building it myself came out cheaper than buying a comparable panel light.

detail.summary: A white and RGB photography light I built instead of buying a finished panel - mostly because doing it myself came out noticeably cheaper.

sections.heading: Why build it
sections.body: A finished panel light with comparable output and color rendering cost significantly more than what I put together myself from LED strips, aluminum profile, and my own driver.

sections.heading: Status
sections.body: It is in regular use for shoots. Build files (wiring diagram, parts list, 3D-printable parts) are being added below as I document them.

projects.title: Portable power supply
projects.description: A high-capacity power bank / portable power supply. Currently a work in progress.

detail.summary: A portable, high-capacity power source for field use and hardware projects away from a wall outlet. Currently being built - this page will grow alongside it.

sections.heading: Goal
sections.body: Build my own high-capacity power bank / portable supply that can actually run demanding hardware projects, not just top up a phone.

sections.heading: Status
sections.body: Work in progress. Wiring diagram, parts list, and build photos will be added as the project moves forward.
